Fires 3 Moebius Anchors per volley, with up to 2 volleys per activation.

Dealing damage during the Super linearly increases Moebius Anchor and Bow Damage. Dealing approximately 3000 damage reaches the maximum bonuses of 127% increased Moebius Anchor Damage and 150% increased Bow Damage (75% for Crossbows). Progress uses actual damage dealt but ignores Power Delta.

Each anchor deals <pve 1,076 /> <pvp [?] /> direct damage, <void Suppresses /> and <void Weakens /> the target, and makes it <void Volatile />. Anchors deal 20% increased damage to tethered enemies and are <link Constructs [#CombatantClassifications] /> with ? HP.

Enemies within 7 meters of an anchor are tethered, <void Weakened />, and <void Suppressed />. Other tethered enemies also take 50% of the base bodyshot damage dealt to a tethered enemy.

Each anchor lasts 6 seconds. Tethered enemy kills extend its duration by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 25 seconds.

source.text:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]
Super Duration: 16 seconds [20 with Orpheus Rigs]

Shadowshot fires 3 Moebius Anchors up to 2 times per activation.
Dealing damage while Shadowshot is active linearly grants increased Moebius Anchor and Bow Weapon Damage.
Maxes out at 127% increased Moebius Anchor Damage and 150% [75% Crossbow] increased Bow Weapon Damage after dealing ~3000 damage.
Damage requirement IGNORES Power-Delta, but considers ACTUAL DAMAGE DEALT.

Moebius Anchor:
Deals 1,076 [?] Damage and inflicts Suppression, Volatile, and Weaken on impact. Counts as a Construct with ? HP.
Enemies within 7 meters of the anchor are tethered. Deals 20% increased damage to tethered enemies. Tethered enemies are inflicted with Weaken and Suppression.
50% of the Bodyshot (Base) Damage dealt to tethered enemies is also inflicted to other tethered enemies.

Moebius Anchor lasts for 6 seconds by default. Tethered Enemy kills increase its duration by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 25 seconds.
Tier 3 Super

Base Cooldown:
500 seconds
